people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
translations.bsb: Then they seized Jesus, led Him away, and took Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed at a distance.
translations.kjv: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
translations.asv: And they seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest's house. But Peter followed afar off.
